{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for any non-numeric characters in revenue
print("Any non-numeric characters in revenue?", sales['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9.\-]').any())

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# (even if none are present, safe to strip)
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm conversion
print("Data type of revenue after conversion:", sales['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_count = (sales['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}")"}
